payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Build an animation-heavy interface with scroll-triggered animations, microinteractions, parallax scrolling (3-5 layers), smooth transitions (300-400ms), entrance animations, page transitions. Use Intersection Observer for scroll effects, transform for performance, GPU acceleration.
payload.best_for: Portfolio sites, storytelling platforms, interactive experiences, entertainment apps, creative, SaaS
payload.css_technical_keywords: animation: @keyframes scroll-reveal, transform: translateY/X, Intersection Observer API, will-change: transform, scroll-behavior: smooth, animation-duration: 300-400ms
payload.do_not_use_for: Data dashboards, critical accessibility, low-power devices, content-heavy, motion-sensitive
payload.effects_and_animation: Scroll anim (Intersection Observer), hover (300-400ms), entrance, parallax (3-5 layers), page transitions
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Scroll animations active, ☐ Parallax 3-5 layers, ☐ Entrance animations smooth, ☐ Page transitions fluid, ☐ GPU accelerated, ☐ Prefers-reduced-motion respected
payload.keywords: Animation-heavy, microinteractions, smooth transitions, scroll effects, parallax, entrance anim, page transitions
payload.primary_colors: Bold colors emphasize movement, high contrast animated, dynamic gradients, accent action colors
payload.secondary_colors: Transitional states, success (Green #22C55E), error (Red #EF4444), neutral feedback
